svg.text: Same zones. Straight streets. Each shop is a stop on one road.
Worst view 3. Today 5. Scale: the runway is the pale strip.
Every city: A G N P S. Colored blocks are one of a kind. North is up.

Gold road is the highway. Dashed oval is a later track. Dashed lots are later games. Dashed box by an arch is a suggested pull-off. Kit dots are drawn large so the stalls show. The Stage has the full cafe instead of a snack.
